title: Mailbox Sweep & Seal
description: Implement the `wdd sweep` command in `lib/wdd/cli.py` and `lib/wdd/mailbox.py`. This reads the outbox, verifies the signature on the associated `receipt.json`, and if valid, moves the envelope to `mailbox/archive/` and marks it SEALED.

requirements.verification: Must verify the cryptographic signature on the receipt before archiving the workorder.

acceptance_criteria: `wdd sweep` successfully archives a signed outbox envelope.
failure_modes: FAIL: Archiving envelopes with invalid signatures.
